author: Antonialock
body:
Thanks! I curated a bacterial entry Q15JF7  that has the same exact interpros (and erroneous trehalase annotations...) as the pombe protein so it will invalidate the condition set. The bacterial entry is a Glucan 1,4-alpha-glucosidase that contributes to validamycin A production, probably by supplying the D-glucose that is converted to UDP-glucose, the glucosyl donor in the final step of validamycin A biosynthesis. 

The entry might not be integrated before the next freeze (27_01 freeze scheduled in a few days) so it might not be fixed until the 27_02 release... I will check back
